description: Recent NSE/BSE corporate filings with MarketPing's AI classification — subject, category, document type, importance and sentiment. This is MarketPing's core dataset: use it for 'what has X announced lately', 'any news on X', or (with no company) 'what is happening in the market today'. The classification is MarketPing's reading; to read a filing ITSELF, call fetch with id 'alert:<id>' — it returns the filing's own text, and for a results statement the company's filed figures. Each filing also carries `source_url`, the original document as filed on BSE or NSE (null when it has none), to cite. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.
name: recent_alerts
title: Recent corporate announcements
